data.name: Blocky Colony
data.detailed_description:
Build a voxel Caribbean colony where every block matters.

Start with a small procedurally generated tropical island and turn it into a thriving colony. Inspired by the history, culture, and island life of Antigua & Barbuda and the wider Caribbean, this voxel colony builder challenges you to make the most of limited land, limited resources, and growing threats from beyond your shores.

Name your island, create your flag, and shape your settlement from the ground up. Build block by block for full creative control, or place prefabs to speed up larger projects. Plan homes, roads, farms, defenses, and industries carefully, because on a small island, every piece of space counts.

Your colony cannot survive on building alone. Choose a main industry, produce goods, and earn money by exporting sugar, fruits, fish, and other Caribbean resources. Import the supplies your island cannot produce, manage trade routes, assign citizens to specific tasks, and keep your economy moving as your population grows.

As your island develops, so does the danger. Research weapons, build defenses, and prepare your citizens for outside threats. Explore your colony in third person from a citizen’s point of view, experience unpredictable tropical weather, and build a Caribbean island strong enough to survive.

data.short_description: A voxel colony-building strategy sim inspired by Antigua and Barbuda and the wider Caribbean's history. Build block by block, manage citizens, trade exports and imports, and defend a small tropical island where every space and shipment matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
